notes.title: Save Your Nuts v2.0 now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Call your friends: Play with Any Controllers—Even Your Phone![/b] 
Finding extra controllers for local party mode can be a hassle, but not anymore! Our latest update allows up to 8 players to join the fun using a variety of gamepads. Whether it's your trusted Xbox or PlayStation controllers, or any device supporting DirectInput, XInput, or RawInput, we've got you covered!

Don’t have enough controllers? No worries! Your smartphone can now transform into a gamepad in seconds. Simply scan the QR code displayed on-screen, and voila—a virtual gamepad appears right in your browser. Dive into the action effortlessly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31283398/7c3e4b7377f819602800e8a92e90d20560c6867c.jpg[/img]

[b]Cross-Platform Magic: Connect Steam and Epic Store Players[/b] We're thrilled to announce that the game is now available on the Epic Store! To celebrate, we've enhanced the online multiplayer mode, enabling seamless gameplay between Steam and Epic Store players. Plus, we’ve squashed those pesky bugs to ensure a smoother and more immersive online experience for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31283398/6ea40c1201ceaf277ec8b23142c502811570e9d3.png[/img]

notes.title: June 2021 update
notes.notes:
Hello, I have been busy porting the game on consoles (XboxOne, XboxSerieS/X, PS4, PS5, and Switch), but this process considerably improved the quality of the game because it passed the certification of Microsoft, Sony, and Nintendo!

[b]In this PC update, you can find all those improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Invite system for online multiplayer: send invites to your Steam friends directly from the Steam chat or the new invite button in the game.
[*] Change game mode without having recreated a party. You can now change the game mode in the pause menu.
[*] Graphical improvements: better textures and shaders 
[*] Performance optimization: more FPS for old computers
[*] Better support of the mouse/keyboard to add an extra player in couch party mode
[*] Polish: manage controller disconnection, display tips, and error messages want necessary.
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Let me know if you enjoy those improvements and if you have new suggestions to improve the game ;)

Thanks,
Fred
Triple Scale Games

notes.title: Patch v1.1 - Fix, Polish and community request

CHANGE LIST

[b]Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improve inputs managements by letting the player choose in the settings if the 1st controller should control the same player of the mouse/keyboard or not
[*]Fix bug prevening to press B to go to the previous menu in online modes
[/list]

[b]AI improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]AI have can now shoot to score on the basketball arena 
[*]AI search for power-ups more efficiently especially during the battle mode
[*]Fix bug where bots were running in circles in the space station
[/list]

[b]Sound:[/b]
[list]
[*]Music doesn't loop anymore, at the end of a track different music will play so it's get let repetitive
[*]Remove double squirrel sounds when joining
[/list]

[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduce the size of the punch FX to improve the visibility
[*]Fix a bug preventing to see the character highlight in online modes
[*]Hide the arrows of extra players not used in the local multiplayer character selection
[*]Fix bug playing the grab animation and sound after throwing the nut
[*]Display the "steal" message over the houses more accurately  
[/list]

[b]Power-ups:[/b]
[list]
[*]Avoid to spawn more than one canon and spawn it a useful angle
[*]Bombs and canons can now break the ice of the frozen lake
[/list]

[b]Level design:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjust bumper and stairs basketball arena
[*]Improve camera management in basketball, pirate ship, and train station
[/list]

[b]Information:[/b]
[list]
[*]Add explanations about how to unlock new arenas
[*]Fix some localizations issues
[*]Show the message "The host stopped the server" when necessary
[*]Fix overlap warnings when try to start a match when some players are not ready
[*]Fix bug showing the message "Goal" when stealing balls on Soccer and Basketball arenas
[*]Increase chance to unlock hats
[/list]

let us know if you find issues or if you have some suggestions to improve the game.
Regards,
Fred

notes.title: Save Your Nuts 1.0 is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone. Time to bust some nuts!

After a year in development, an important page in [i]Save Your Nuts[/i] is coming to a close - the game is finally out of Early Access! XboxOne and Switch versions are also coming out today.

To celebrate, [i]Save Your Nuts[/i] 1.0 will be sold with a -15% discount for a week, until April 22nd.
Act now, while the offer lasts! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31283398/95d0d34b6c59015064d09d17643bb8836f8c9165.png[/img]

This update is featuring:[list]
[*]A funny intro cinematic explaining the context of this nutty competition
[*]2 new arenas with sport gameplay styles (soccer and basketball)
[*]2 powerful bonus items available when digging on red crosses (Canon and Giant)
[*]Lots of bug fixes and visual quality improvements
[/list]

DEMO
A free demo is also available to try the tutorial and the coach party "Capture the Nut" mode with the 2 first arenas. Play from 1 to 8 players + AI.

Remote Play Together
We know it's not always easy to invite 8 people to play together, so Save Your Nuts let you use the Steam feature "Remote Play Together". Your friends who don't own the game can still join your local party from their own place. Just select the option "Remote Play Together" for each person you want to invite in the friend list.

We’d like to thank each and every one of our fans who is providing valuable feedback on bugs and errors in Early Access, sharing your thoughts on the game’s balance and content, and just giving our team enough motivation for us to pull ourselves towards Version 1.0! 

Regards,
Fred
Triple Scale Games

notes.title: Full release with a new update coming up on April 16th!

[*]2 new arenas with new gameplay styles (soccer and basketball)

notes.title: Visuals and bots imporvements

Patch Note v0.143
[h1]Change list:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Player name (tag) can be customized in party mode: you can write your name on the top of your character to recognize it easily 
[*]Improve the textures of characters
[*]Visibility of the nuts: the nuts are now glowing more and have a particle effect
[*]Add icons to power-ups
[*]Add a button to see characters specialty description in the character selection screen
[*]Balancing: the Armadillo now run a bit faster
[*]Bot improvement in battle: do not try to attack shielded enemy anymore

[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

Tell us what do you think about it on our [url=https://discord.gg/twesWTz]Discord server[/url] or on the Community HUB. We hope you like it!

notes.title: New Achievements, Shield, UI, and more...
notes.notes:
Hey, too hot outside to search for more nuts? Take a break and try the new Save Your Nuts update.

Patch Note v0.138
[h1][b]Change list:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][h1]Achievements[/h1]
27 new funny and challenging achievements to unlock, check the list in the library (icons are coming soon).
[*][h1]Shield[/h1]
You can hit the left trigger (or shift key) to use a shield to defend yourself. Good timing is necessary as the shield doesn't last long but it reload over time.
[*][h1]New Character Selection Screen[/h1]
Simpler and more practical to join the party and customize your pets and bots.
[*][h1]Improve Character Textures[/h1]
[*][h1]Polish UI[/h1]
[*][h1]Polish Collisions[/h1]
[*][h1]Improve Musics[/h1]
[*][h1]Bugs fixes[/h1]
[/list]

Tell us what do you think about it on our [url=https://discord.gg/twesWTz]Discord server[/url] or on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/752170/discussions/0/]Community HUB[/url]. We hope you like it!

Cheers,
Fred

notes.title: Online multiplayer is now available in the main branch! Patch Note v0.134
notes.notes:
Hello, we have worked hard to improve the online multiplayer (bug fix and network optimization). We decided to make it accessible in the main branch, so more people can play together. 

Here is the list of modifications of the new build v0.134:
- Fix character flickering on client site (online) + Network optimizations
- Fix a bug making the cannon of the pirate ships not respawn correctly
- Fix collisions making the AI stuck
- Fix character being stuck sometimes when waking up after being KO
- Reorganize arenas selection menu
- Fix extra bot in the stats tab after a player leaves
- Fix to avoid client to be able to grab more than 1 nut at a time
- Fix to allow clients to steal nut on the pirate ships during thieves mode

[b]Online multiplayer is now available in the main branch![/b]

Let us know if you experience issues or if you have suggestions. 
We are planning to add dedicated servers and matchmaking as soon as possible.

Thanks,
Fred
